VERSION = 2012
PATCHLEVEL = 07
SUBLEVEL =
EXTRAVERSION =

ARCH = arm
export	ARCH CPU BOARD VENDOR SOC


#########################################################################
# Build MIPS Image Related Setting

MIPS_BOOTLOAD_LIB_NAME		= libbootload.a
MIPS_BOOTLOAD_LIB_DIR		= $(TOPDIR)/../bsp/core/image/src/app
MIPS_BOOTLOAD_LIB_PATH		= $(MIPS_BOOTLOAD_LIB_DIR)/$(MIPS_BOOTLOAD_LIB_NAME)


CFLAGS += --sysroot=$(TOOLCHAIN_READY)/sysroots/ca9v1-starfishmllib32-linux-gnueabi
include $(PRJ).inc

# Note: This is LG Git. we use lg toolchain even in generic board here. 
# because We assume everyone use this bootcode is for LG project. If you need to use rtk toolchain,please change by yourself.
TOOL_DIR      ?= $(LG_TOOLCHAIN_PATH)/sysroots/x86_64-starfishsdk-linux/usr/bin/arm-starfish-linux-gnueabi
TARGET        ?= arm-starfish-linux-gnueabi
TOOL_BIN      ?= $(TOOL_DIR)

# Below patch is used to prevent the verify failture problem of JenkinsMK2.
# If we branch the codebase to LGE Git, we should remove below patch first.
TOOLCHAIN_READY = $(LG_TOOLCHAIN_PATH)

export TOOLCHAIN_READY


TARGET_CPU    = arm
CROSS_COMPILE = $(TARGET)-
